baseline_scope: Native is unchanged author PhysTwin spring-force kernel inside this study shared graph/mass/contact/integration and positive-J guard. It is not the full authors optimizer/model/pipeline; guarded adaptation failures are not full-method PhysTwin failures.
validity_definition: Completed full calibration trajectory with consistent frozen job/settings, matching finite arrays/times/initial geometry and positive integrated J. Penetration threshold is reported separately, not used to silently remove a completed calibration hypothesis. No forecast performance follows from library coverage.
